crossRefs.note: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours.…
Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck…
All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all…

translations.web: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,
translations.bsb: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites,
translations.kjv: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
translations.asv: And for the redemption of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the first-born of the children of Israel, that are over and above the number of the Levites,
